params._comment: CUT-INTRO reshoot: banking crane + speed-ramp dive. The descending spiral now BANKS — the horizon rolls into each curve (-3 / +3.5 / -3 deg, never past 4) and levels for the dive. Cruise FOV settles 68->62; the easeInOutSine cruise decelerates INTO t=0.8 (a hesitation at the edge, covered by the storm_pulse sting), then one long easeInQuad segment accelerates ~97 blocks into the smoke wall while the FOV pulls 63->78 — the speed ramp reads as lens breathing + true blocks/tick gain, peaking right as the fade covers the hand-off. Wind buffet builds in two gusts: the 3.2-freq flutter at t=0.86 (decays by ~t 824) and a stronger 3.6-freq wall gust at t=0.95 that stays live through the fade rise (864-880) — the first gust alone died 40t before the fade, leaving the fastest stretch of the dive shake-free (REPASS polish; v6's overlap intent, now arithmetically true). Keyframes are OFFSETS from the play anchor (vortex ground center); the whisper at 0.24 stays aligned with the t=300-absolute vortex spawn. Fade retimed 0.955->0.96 (16,12,26) so the FOV pull stays visible longer; still fully black before control returns at t=900.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
